dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) with ACUCOBOL-style HANDLE OF WINDOW in LINKAGE SECTION; Italian-language business application 'GESLUX' warehouse/inventory management system; uses SPECIAL-NAMES decimal-point is comma (European locale)
evidence: copy files with .sl and .fd extensions typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: Italian warehouse/inventory management system (GESLUX) - peso (weight) conversion utility that migrates article/product records from OLD format files to new format files, converting weight fields across multiple business data files
purpose.summary: This program is a data migration/conversion utility for the GESLUX Italian ERP/warehouse management system. It reads records from OLD-prefixed versions of many business files (articles, orders, movements, price lists, etc.) and writes them to new-format files, performing field-by-field mapping. The program name 'peso-conv-p' and title 'Aumento peso' suggest it specifically handles weight field expansion/conversion.

notable_features: USAGE IS HANDLE OF WINDOW in LINKAGE SECTION (ACUCOBOL/GnuCOBOL GUI handle)
96 COPY statements for .sl and .fd file definitions
ACCEPT from ENVIRONMENT for path configuration
Parallel OLD-/new file pairs for data migration
Italian-language field names and file names
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 1470 lines. The HANDLE OF WINDOW in LINKAGE suggests this may be called from a GUI shell program. File extensions .sl and .fd are characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL indexed file definitions. The dialect could also be Micro-Focus or ACUCOBOL given the HANDLE OF WINDOW usage, but GnuCOBOL is most likely given the open-source Italian GESLUX context.
